definitions.explanation: A marine cephalopod with eight arms and a soft body. Octopus is a popular food ingredient in Japan.

examples.notes: Octopus arms are called {足|あし} (legs) in Japanese

{蛸|たこ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{吸盤|きゅうばん}→吸盤：noentry⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{岩|いわ}→岩：00850_iwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧⟦{張|は}り{付|つ}く→張り付く：06048_haritsuku⟧。

notes:
{蛸|たこ} refers to octopus.

Alternative writing: ⟦タコ→タコ：noentry⟧ (katakana, common)

Common dishes:
- ⟦{蛸焼|たこや}き→たこ焼き：10364_takoyaki⟧ (takoyaki - octopus balls)
- {蛸|たこ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧ (octopus sashimi)
- {蛸|たこ}⟦{酢|す}→酢：01057_su⟧ (vinegared octopus)
- ⟦{明石焼|あかしや}き→明石焼き：noentry⟧ (Akashi-style octopus dumplings)

Common expressions:
- ⟦{蛸部屋|たこべや}→蛸部屋：noentry⟧ (cramped workers' quarters; literally "octopus room")
- ⟦{蛸足配線|たこあしはいせん}→蛸足配線：noentry⟧ (power strip with multiple outlets; "octopus leg wiring")

Counter: ⟦{匹|ひき}→匹：00939_hiki⟧

Cultural note:
Octopus has a different image in Japan compared to Western countries - it's considered a delicious food rather than strange or scary. ⟦{蛸焼|たこや}き→たこ焼き：10364_takoyaki⟧ from Osaka is one of Japan's most famous street foods.
